usageNote: 日常健康话题必备短语！说运动好处时超常用，听起来专业又自然～

examples.en: Regular exercise helps keep our muscles and bones in good condition as we age.
examples.zh: 随着年龄增长，定期锻炼有助于保持我们的肌肉和骨骼健康。

examples.en: Eating enough calcium and protein is essential to keep our muscles and bones in good condition.
examples.zh: 摄入足够的钙和蛋白质对保持肌肉和骨骼健康至关重要。
